1.text: Uwiteka abwira Mose ati “Bwira abatambyi bene Aroni uti: Ntihakagire uwo muri mwe wiyandurisha intumbi ngo yandurire hagati mu bwoko bwe,

2.text: keretse yakwanduzwa n'iya mwene wabo wa bugufi, nyina na se, n'umuhungu we, n'umukobwa we na mwene se,

3.text: na mushiki we wari ukiri umwari, akaba mwene wabo wa bugufi kuko atararongorwa, intumbi ye yayiyandurisha.

4.text: Ubwo ari umukuru mu bwoko bwe, ntakiyanduze ngo yiyonone.

5.text: “Ntibakogoshwe ibiharonjongo, ntibakiyogoshe inkokora z'ubwanwa bwabo, ntibakikebe ku mubiri.

6.text: Babere Imana yabo abera, ntibagasuzuguze izina ry'Imana yabo, kuko ari bo batambira Uwiteka ibitambo bikongorwa n'umuriro, ari byo byokurya by'Imana yabo. Ni cyo gituma bakwiriye kuba abera.

7.text: Ntibakarongore malaya cyangwa uwanduye, kandi ntibagacyure uwasenzwe, kuko umutambyi ari uwera ku Mana ye.

8.text: Ni cyo gituma ukwiriye guhora umutekereza ko ari uwera, kuko ajya atamba ibyokurya by'Imana yawe, ahora akubera uwera kuko Uwiteka ukweza ndi uwera.

9.text: Kandi umukobwa w'umutambyi wese niyiyononesha gusambana, aba yononnye se, bamutwike.

10.text: “Umutambyi mukuru muri bagenzi be wasutswe ku mutwe amavuta ya elayo yo gusīga, akerezwa kwambara ya myambaro, ntagatendeze umusatsi we, ntagashishimure imyenda ye,

11.text: ntakinjire aho intumbi yose iri, ntakiyandurishe intumbi ya se cyangwa nyina,

12.text: ntibikamukure Ahera, ntakonone Ahera h'Imana ye, kuko kwereshwa amavuta yasīzwe y'Imana ye kumuriho. Ndi Uwiteka.

13.text: Kandi umukobwa arongora, azabe ari umwari.

14.text: Umupfakazi cyangwa uwasenzwe cyangwa uwanduye, cyangwa malaya ntakabarongore, ahubwo umwari wo mu bwoko bwe azabe ari we arongora.

15.text: Ntakononere urubyaro rwe hagati mu bwoko bwe, kuko ndi Uwiteka umweza.”

17.text: “Bwira Aroni uti ‘Umuntu wese wo mu rubyaro rwawe mu bihe byabo byose uzagira inenge, ntakigire hafi ngo atambe ibyokurya by'Imana ye.

18.text: Umuntu wese ufite inenge ntakigire hafi: impumyi cyangwa uremaye ukuguru, cyangwa ubutaraye izuru, cyangwa ufite urugingo ruruta urundi nka rwo,

20.text: cyangwa ufite inyonjo cyangwa igikuri, cyangwa ufite inenge ku jisho, cyangwa urwaye ubuheri cyangwa ibikoko, cyangwa umenetse ibinyita bito.

21.text: Ntihakagire umuntu wo mu rubyaro rwa Aroni umutambyi ufite inenge, wigira hafi ngo atambe ibitambo bitambirwa Uwiteka bigakongorwa n'umuriro. Kuko afite inenge, ntakigire hafi ngo atambe ibyokurya by'Imana ye.

22.text: Ajye arya ku byokurya by'Imana ye, ku byera cyane no ku byera.

23.text: Ariko ntakigire hafi ya wa mwenda ukingiriza Ahera cyane, ntakegere igicaniro kuko afite inenge, kugira ngo atagira Ahera hanjye yonona, kuko ndi Uwiteka uheza.’ ”

24.text: Ibyo byose Mose abibwira Aroni n'abana be n'Abisirayeli bose.
